name: d2-connected-worlds
description: DKU Library and Duke Gothic Reading Room, connected by the atrium stair and the south door.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm ci --prefix dku && npm ci --prefix duke
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n dku,duke -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix dku" "npm run dev --prefix duke"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix dku -- --outDir ../dist --emptyOutDir && npm run build --prefix duke -- --outDir ../dist/duke --emptyOutDir
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix dku && npm run typecheck --prefix duke
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke --prefix dku && npm run smoke --prefix duke && node tools/smoke-portal.mjs
